bio.text: Mike DeCillis is the Democratic nominee for New York's 11th Congressional District, challenging Republican Rep. Nicole Malliotakis, according to NY1 in September 2026.
BK Reader reported in May 2026 that he is a Staten Island native who has lived in Bay Ridge for 14 years, and that he began as an EMS paramedic and 9/11 first responder.
The same report says he worked as a police officer for 10 years while attending New York Law School, became a civil litigation attorney, and later taught in a District 75 public school.
It also says he later served as chief of staff for Assembly District 46 and as assistant counsel for the New York City Districting Commission.
